gloss_en: Leshon HaKodesh — the Holy Tongue (Hebrew) as the sacred language through which the world was created; identified in Likutey Moharan 19 with Chavah/the woman/holy speech (dibbur) and with ruach hakodesh, the language whose power casts down the seventy languages and restrains the lust of adultery — the Holy Tongue itself as an entity, distinct from the separate concept of its 'perfection' (shlemut leshon hakodesh)
